verdict.rationale: E2B publishes a dedicated coding-agents use-case page for running Claude Code, Codex and Amp in its sandboxes with terminal, filesystem and git access. It also has a Claude Code agent page offering a pre-built `claude` template with Claude Code already installed, backed by documented command execution and custom templates. Missing for 10: a detailed Codex-specific recipe (only named on the use-case page), and independent or hands-on corroboration of running these agents in E2B.
